project.name: poc-23-remote-embedding-scale
project.description: POC 23: spec selection at scale with a REMOTE EmbeddingService. Runs the real nomic-embed-text-v2 embedding endpoint (an OpenAI-compatible POST /embeddings service, a llama.cpp server proxied by LiteLLM) behind POC 12's SpecScorer seam, on two scenarios: (1) POC 12/20's identical 200+ same-typed shadowing library, so the remote embedding is directly comparable to lexical (POC 8), dense feature-hashing (POC 12), MiniLM (POC 20) and GLiNER2 (POC 17) on claim C10; and (2) a larger generated library, to measure the scaling dimension -- the one-time embedding cost is amortised (one embedding per spec) and per-query retrieval is pure-CPU cosine over cached vectors (O(n), no model call), unlike a per-candidate LLM/transformer selector which needs n model calls per query. Endpoint-gated live run; offline tests use a stub transport so the module stays green without the endpoint.
